question: Does slope measured from orbit (Gale 1 m DTM) match the tilt Curiosity actually experienced on the ground?

baseline.label: No-skill guess: every waypoint = median rover tilt

method: Same procedure as the Perseverance check: each unique Curiosity waypoint inside the USGS MSL Gale Merged DEM 1 m (v3) is mapped to its native pixel; native float32 samples are read from the LZW strips by exact HTTP byte range; a least-squares plane is fitted over a disc around the position and its slope compared with the rover tilt in the NASA MMGIS MSL localisation record.

sources.credit: Curiosity localisation: NASA/JPL-Caltech (MMGIS). DTM: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona/USGS.
